messages:
June (Content): quick alignment  we need final microcopy and routing for the tri-mode landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). scope: 1-line hero + 1-line subhead per mode, two social captions (announce + reminder), webinar headline + 3 takeaways, and explicit form->queue mapping. target: push to staging by 5pm PT.

Arjun (Growth): Ill do socials + UTM matrix. plan: announce (day0) + reminder (day2). A/B matrix: headline test (cost vs latency) x CTA test (RSVP vs Watch Demo). will include utm templates.

Felix - PMM: Ill write subheads and webinar takeaways. focus on buyer outcomes: time-to-ship, unit economics clarity, and compliance guardrails. no hard % claims.

Tori (Ops): routing rules below. include company_email detection, company_size, and a compliance checkbox. add utm_campaign and event_id tagging. if enterprise signals -> priority=high and include enterprise-sdr.

```
form_type -> queue (rules)
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise (company_email OR company_size>250 OR enterprise_keyword)
signup:trial -> growth-trials (company_email)
signup:self-serve -> onboarding-freemium (personal_email)
question:compliance -> solutions-eng (compliance:true)
support:incident -> eng-oncall (severity:high)
```

June (Content): hero drafts (pick one per mode, keep <8 words):
- Hosted: "Start shipping with production inference."
- Hosted (alt): "Instant API for production LLMs."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput."
- Dedicated (alt): "Committed capacity, stable performance."
- Private: "Inference that stays in your network."
- Private (alt): "VPC & on-prem for regulated teams."

Felix - PMM: subheads (short):
- Hosted: "Ship features without managing infra or queues."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput and SLA-backed uptime."
- Private: "Control data locality and access controls."

Felix - PMM: webinar headline + takeaways:
Headline: "Practical Serving: Benchmarks, Decisions, and Runbooks"
Takeaways:
- "What to measure: median latency, tail spikes, cost/unit"
- "How to choose: hosted vs dedicated vs private for your product"
- "Operational steps: rollout patterns, caching, and graceful fallbacks"

Arjun (Growth): social captions + UTM examples:
- Announce (cost headline): "Lower inference unit costs without sacrificing quality. See Hosted, Dedicated, and Private options + benchmarks. Webinar -> [link]?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=cost_headline"
- Reminder (latency headline): "Demo tomorrow: pick the right mode for predictable latency and scaling. Join for benchmarks + live Q&A -> [link]?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=latency_headline"

Tori (Ops): ops notes: add form fields: company_email, company_size, compliance_checkbox, utm_campaign, event_id. If company_size>250 or enterprise_keyword true -> set priority=high and route to sales-enterprise. Tag all webinar signups with event_id and utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch.

DeployBot: reminder  staging deploy window at 17:00 PT. will deploy from /marketing/staging once copy files uploaded.

June (Content): assigning: Arjun finish socials + UTM links; Felix tighten webinar bullets and subheads; Tori add routing rules in CRM and confirm queue names; Ill assemble page copy and upload to staging for review at 16:15 PT. quick signoff thread after upload. :white_check_mark:
